rentalLicensing.summary: Ann Arbor requires a Certificate of Compliance before a dwelling or rooming unit may be leased, issued through the city's rental housing registration and inspection program.

faq.q: Does Ann Arbor require a rental license for a long-term rental?
faq.a: Yes. The city requires a Certificate of Compliance before an owner may lease a dwelling or rooming unit, under its rental housing registration and inspection program.

faq.q: How often does Ann Arbor inspect registered rental units?
faq.a: The city's Rental Housing office inspects registered rental units every 30 months.

rentalLicensing.summary: Daytona Beach requires owners of residential rental properties with fewer than five units to register the property with the city annually, for long-term rentals of six months and one day or longer.

faq.q: Does Daytona Beach require long-term rental properties to register with the city?
faq.a: Yes. The city's rental property ordinance requires owners of residential rental properties with fewer than five units to register annually, covering long-term rentals of six months and one day or longer.

faq.q: Does Daytona Beach inspect registered rental units?
faq.a: No. The city's rental registration program does not require an inspection; an owner may request a voluntary interior and exterior inspection, and a unit that passes has its registration fees waived the following year.

faq.q: What does rental registration cost in Daytona Beach?
faq.a: The program charges a $40 initial application fee, a $50 per-unit initial registration fee and a $75 per-unit annual renewal fee.

faq.q: What is Fulton County's property tax millage rate?
faq.a: Fulton County held its general fund millage rate at 8.87 mills for 2025, equal to 0.887% of assessed value, according to the county. That covers only the county's general fund portion; total property tax bills also include city and school district millage.

sources.title: Fulton County, Fulton Holds Millage Rate at 8.87 Mills for 2025

rentalLicensing.summary: Stockton requires residential rental units to register for inspection in the city's current active inspection area, and the city inspects registered units at least once every five years under Stockton Municipal Code 8.32.

faq.q: Does Stockton require an inspection for residential rental units?
faq.a: Yes. The city inspects residential rental units at least once every five years under Stockton Municipal Code 8.32, and owners register online for properties in the current active inspection area.

faq.q: Does Stockton require a business license for a rental property?
faq.a: Yes, for an owner with three or more rental units or properties, under Stockton Municipal Code 5.08.030(22).

faq.q: What rental properties are exempt from Stockton's inspection program?
faq.a: Hotels, motels and bed and breakfasts are exempt, as are newly built multi-family buildings of four or more units for five years after their building permit is finalized, and subsidized units that pass an annual government inspection.
